maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from new SR Series piston aircraft and Vision Jet sales; service and training are secondary.

publicly_funded.reason: Buyers are private individuals, owner-pilots and businesses purchasing personal aircraft, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by designing and selling its own SR Series and Vision Jet aircraft and opening its own facilities.

mission_critical.reason: Discretionary personal aircraft purchases; buyers could pick other makers, though owners face some service and training lock-in.

notes: Mission-critical is borderline: type-certified aircraft and factory service create some switching cost after purchase.
